landmarks.name: Gateway of India
landmarks.hint: A basalt arch overlooking the Arabian Sea, built to commemorate the 1911 visit of King George V

landmarks.name: Marine Drive
landmarks.hint: A 3-km seaside promenade along the Arabian Sea, nicknamed the Queen's Necklace for its night-time lights

landmarks.name: Elephanta Caves
landmarks.hint: A UNESCO World Heritage Site of rock-cut cave temples on Elephanta Island, dedicated to Shiva

landmarks.name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus
landmarks.hint: A UNESCO World Heritage Victorian Gothic railway station, one of the world's busiest, formerly known as VT

landmarks.name: Haji Ali Dargah
landmarks.hint: A revered mosque and dargah located on a small islet off the Worli coast, accessible by a narrow causeway

landmarks.name: Siddhivinayak Temple
landmarks.hint: One of Mumbai's most visited Ganesha temples in Prabhadevi, attracting celebrities and commoners alike

landmarks.name: Juhu Beach
landmarks.hint: Mumbai's most popular beach, famous for street food, sunsets, and its proximity to Bollywood celebrities

landmarks.name: Dharavi
landmarks.hint: One of the world's largest urban slums, also a thriving informal economy producing goods exported globally

landmarks.name: Bandra–Worli Sea Link
landmarks.hint: A cable-stayed bridge spanning 5.6 km across Mahim Bay, dramatically cutting travel time between Bandra and Worli

landmarks.name: Chowpatty Beach
landmarks.hint: A historic beach at the northern end of Marine Drive, famous for Ganesh Chaturthi immersions and bhel puri
